comment: Kodak VISION3 500T 5219/7219 'Sensitometric Curves' (TI2647F), p.4. All three curves are drawn in the same near-black solid stroke, so each is told apart by its bounding box: B is the top curve, R the bottom. The figure legend says 'Densitometry: ECN-2'; Kodak's camera-negative curves are Status M (the spectral-sensitivity figure on the same page says Status M), so the stock is tagged statusM. The x calibration uses the top LOG EXPOSURE (lux-seconds) axis: its -4.0 and 1.0 labels sit on the frame edges. Its interior ticks are irregular (-3.0 at 390.1, -2.0 at 425.5, -1.0 at 462.0, 0.0 at 502.5 pt against a uniform 36.92 pt per log E), so the frame edges are the reference, giving up to 0.05 log E uncertainty locally.
